LVMH Sales Rise Slightly Amid Fashion Sector Decline

LVMH reported a slight increase in overall sales, despite a downturn in its fashion and leather goods division during the third quarter. This performance has cast a shadow over the fragile recovery of the luxury sector, dashing hopes for a stronger rebound.
